bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to YWCA St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; YWCA ST. PAUL HOUSING PROGRAM. +]

[+$750,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to YWCA St. Paul to administer the YWCA St. Paul housing program that offers permanent supportive housing and transitional housing. Money from the grant must be used to maintain stable housing opportunities; provide direct financial assistance for move-in costs, transportation, rental support, and housing transitions; sustain economic mobility initiatives, ensuring participants can pursue job training, higher education, and financial independence; and expand case management and support services, including mental health services, financial literacy, and workforce development. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for a grant to YWCA St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; YWCA ST. PAUL HOUSING PROGRAM.

$750,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for a grant to YWCA St. Paul to administer the YWCA St. Paul housing program that offers permanent supportive housing and transitional housing. Money from the grant must be used to maintain stable housing opportunities; provide direct financial assistance for move-in costs, transportation, rental support, and housing transitions; sustain economic mobility initiatives, ensuring participants can pursue job training, higher education, and financial independence; and expand case management and support services, including mental health services, financial literacy, and workforce development. This is a onetime appropriation.
